items.title: Self-service project setup: owners create projects and publish revisions directly
items.body:
## Summary
This replaces the admin application workflow with self-service project setup (audit findings 1, 2 and 16; work package order 1).

An owner creates a project directly. The server checks GitHub repository identity and the owner's current authority, lists the project paused at once, queues its first malicious-code scan through the existing vetting queue, and returns **one setup status**: the result, a single next action, and the authority, Slopbot installation and scan checks. Funding is reported separately. A setup check activates the project, as a status-only revision, when Slopbot's installation reads write, maintain or admin access for the person running the check and the exact current content has a clean scan. When GitHub or Slopbot can't be reached, the owner is told to retry; nothing becomes an admin task.

Owners publish their own revisions. Each change is classified:
- presentation: publishes immediately;
- contribution rules: pause an active project and queue a new scan;
- financial: applies from the next UTC month.

Applications submitted before this change are published by their own applicant without retyping anything.

## PRD and MVP references
- PRD section 4 (self-service admission, setup status, owners publish revisions, changed executable content needs fresh clearance); section 5 (Slopbot installation required before ready); section 6 (one optional funding mode, no tokens shown as dollars, prospective economic changes); section 7 (one status summary per project, next action, distinct failure states).
- Requirement IDs: PRJ-01, PRJ-02, PRJ-05 (referrer kept), SKL-03/SKL-04 (generated skills unchanged), VET-01/VET-07 (clearance gate).
- MVP work package: MVP-03.
- Issues: #908, #906.

## What changed
- **API (`backend/projects/handler.ts`, new `backend/projects/setup.ts`)**
  - `POST /api/v1/projects` creates a project.
  - `PUT /api/v1/projects/:id` publishes an owner revision against `expectedRevision`.
  - `GET /api/v1/project-setup` lists the account's projects and pending stored applications.
  - `POST /api/v1/project-setup/:id/check` runs the checks, queues a needed scan, and activates a passing project.
  - `POST /api/v1/project-applications/:id/publish` migrates a stored application.
  - Removed: admin approve/reject routes, the admin application list, the pending-application limit and the admin email call. Admin `PUT admin/projects/:id/manifest` stays as the exception path.
  - The activation gate now applies to activation, or to changing skill inputs while active, so a presentation edit is not blocked by a stale branch pin.
- **Authority.** A manifest that contradicts GitHub is refused. Slopbot's installation is authoritative for the permission level (write, maintain or admin required). Before installation, public GitHub facts allow creating and editing the paused project only; activation always needs the installation read.
- **Slopbot (`workers/slopbot/repository-access.ts`).** New internal route `https://slopbot.internal/v1/repository-access`, reached only over a `SLOPBOT` service binding. It returns installation state and the account's base permission, using the App JWT and an installation token. It checks the repository id and returns no token.
- **Scan digest (`src/lib/project-revision-changes.ts`, `backend/vetting/persistence.ts`).** The clearance now binds only executable fields (id, repositories, skill, reviewSkill, contribution). One classifier drives both server rules and UI hints.
- **Notifications.** No approval notice for an owner's own action. Revision and enforcement notices reach self-service creators and skip the revision's own author.
- **UI**
  - `/projects/new`: creates the project directly and shows a `ProjectSetupStatusPanel` (install Slopbot, wait for or request a scan, retry), with funding shown separately.
  - Rewards step: one optional choice, "No monthly funding" or a monthly amount with network and asset; token details only after that choice. Amounts are labelled in the asset, never USD. The review budget option and admin readiness text are gone.
  - Manage page: publishes directly, keeps the on-device draft, diff and stale-revision guard, and explains what each change needs. The admin change brief is removed.
  - "Your projects" lists projects with their status and lets an applicant publish a stored application.
  - The admin page loses the approval queue.
- **No migration.** Number 0059 is unused.

## Tests
- `bun run typecheck`: pass.
- Biome on changed files: 0 errors. Remaining warnings are pre-existing ones in `scripts/vetting-api.test.ts`.
- Project, notification, GitHub-check, vetting and legacy-registry suites (8 files, run serially): 67 pass, 0 fail.
- `scripts/project-self-service.test.ts` + `workers/slopbot/repository-access.test.ts`: 12 pass.
- `bun test ./workers/slopbot`: 48 pass.
- Other affected suites (owner awards, contributor skill, staging payments, terms preflight, Robinhood schema): 11 pass.
- Preview-lane Playwright, desktop Chromium (`tests/e2e/project-proposal.spec.ts`, plus the manage-page tests in `tests/e2e/site.spec.ts`): 8 passed. The run found a real bug, fixed in commit 3: an unedited legacy reward asset was being rebuilt.

## Not verified
- Registry-lane e2e (`tests/e2e/registry.spec.ts`), `security-bounty.spec.ts` and `evidence-download.spec.ts` still list projects through the removed approval routes and need rewriting.
- Mobile, keyboard and 200% zoom checks, and video evidence, were not done.
- The outer `bun run build` needs live leaderboard data, so it was not run here.
- No live GitHub, Slopbot, scanner, chain or provider calls. The GitHub permission endpoint has not been verified against real GitHub with the App's permissions.
- `SLOPBOT` is not bound in `wrangler.toml` because the Slopbot Worker isn't deployed. Until it is bound, setup reports the installation check as a retry and nothing activates.

## Open owner decisions
1. Should creating a project already require the installation read? Today, public GitHub facts are enough to create the paused project; this guards against squatting.
2. Confirm "prospective" means from the next UTC calendar month (pinned through `cycleCaps`).
3. The executable-field definition for the scan digest must agree with the vetting scope work.
4. The schema still stores monthly amounts in 6-decimal "$" units even for tokens; it needs a move to asset base units.
5. "No monthly funding" stores no asset or vault, so the network is chosen when funding is added.
6. A project paused by a plain admin revision can be reactivated by its owner's check; admins should use quarantine to hold one.

## Related
#908, #906. Follow-ups: vetting result hook for activation the moment a scan finishes; dead `workers/notify` application email; AGENTS.md review-budget and admin-approval text.

items.title: fix: resolve #29 - Non-ASCII queries (UTF-8)?
items.body:
## 🎯 Autonomous Bounty Resolution

/claim #29

### Overview
This pull request resolves issue #29: **Non-ASCII queries (UTF-8)?**.

### Root Cause Analysis
Mairix tokenization historically restricted valid word characters to ASCII alphanumeric characters ('a'-'z', 'A'-'Z', '0'-'9'). Non-ASCII / UTF-8 multi-byte sequence bytes (which have the top bit set, i.e. >= 0x80 / 128) were treated as token delimiters, preventing non-ASCII UTF-8 words from being indexed or queried as complete tokens.

### Changes & Implementation
Allow bytes with the top bit set (>= 128) to be recognized as valid word characters during tokenization. This enables full support for non-ASCII / UTF-8 multi-byte strings in search queries and index building without affecting ASCII case folding or hashing.

### Claim & Payout
- /claim #29
- Resolves #29
- Targeted Reward: **$150 USD**
- Stream: **Algora Escrow**

items.title: Lack of validation, bounds checking, and ISO format on payment creation endpoint
items.body:
**IMPORTANT: Only the issue creator (@whyst0ne) is authorized to submit a PR for this issue. Any uninvited PRs from other accounts will be rejected and closed.**

### Bug Description
The payment creation endpoint `POST /api/payments` currently accepts arbitrary request bodies without validation or bounds checking. Requests with missing amount, negative amounts, zero amounts, non-numeric values, or amounts exceeding upper thresholds (such as 1,000,000) are processed directly. Additionally, currencies are not validated against standard 3-letter ISO formats, leading to potential financial exploitation and database inconsistencies.

### Requirements
- Create `createPaymentSchema` in `apps/api/src/validators/payment.js` with positive numeric amount (max 1,000,000) and 3-letter ISO currency bounds (defaulting to "usd").
- Update `apps/api/src/controllers/paymentController.js` to parse request payload and forward errors via `next(err)`.
- Ensure `apps/api/src/middleware/errorHandler.js` handles `ZodError` returning HTTP 400 with `{ ok: false, error: err.message, issues: err.issues }`.
- Add automated tests in `apps/api/src/tests/payment.test.js` verifying valid creation and all boundary conditions.

Resolves requirement under bounty program rules #743.

items.title: fix(home): show bounties created on the site in the homepage hand, team ones first
items.body:
## Summary Reported by **Vlad** on Discord: new bounties weren't showing on the homepage. That report is what put this on the list, and we'll have more bounties going up soon, so it needed fixing now. - **Cause:** the homepage hand read only poidh V3 bounties and kept the skate/surf ones by keyword. Bounties created on this site live in the PoidhSopa contract, which the homepage never read. The one open team bounty today (*Gnars x Nouns Mini App*, 30 USDC) was on `/community/bounties` but not on `/`. - **Fix:** open Sopa bounties now join the hand. Bounties from team wallets (`POIDH_SOPA.teamIssuers`) lead it, newest first, with a **⌐◨-◨ GNARS TEAM** mark. Everything else, community Sopa bounties and poidh skate/surf, ranks by USD value, so a near-zero bounty from anyone sinks instead of taking the Legendary slot. Team test guide (PT-BR, before/after and steps): https://claude.ai/artifact/9fju3yZTncC6JteGhBWgXN ## Before / after Same live data. "Before" is gnars.com today; "After" is this PR's production build. **Desktop, 1280 px** | Before | After | | :---: | :---: | | | | | 5 poidh bounties. The team bounty is missing. | Team bounty in the centre: `GN-TECH-00`, team mark, 30 USDC. | **Phone, 390 px, PT-BR** | Before | After | | :---: | :---: | | | | | Row opened on an arbitrary poidh card. | Row opens on the headline card, in rank order. |
Card back: the claim goes to the bounty's page on this site poidh cards still send the claim to poidh.xyz in a new tab.
## Changes - `src/lib/config.ts`: `POIDH_SOPA.teamIssuers` (SOPA `0xa642…fd68` for now, the issuer of today's bounties) and `isPoidhSopaTeamIssuer()`. **Add team wallets here.** - `src/components/newhome/bounty-hand.ts`: pure ranking: `selectSopaShowcase`, `rankHand` (team first, rest by USD; without an ETH price, ETH rewards rank first), `handTotals` (ETH + USDC at face value), `sopaCode` (`GN-` prefix, since Sopa ids overlap poidh's; `Object.hasOwn` on the on-chain category slug). - `BountiesSection.tsx`: - reads Sopa next to poidh; - each source fails on its own: one down keeps the other's cards with a notice, and the tiles read "unavailable" instead of an understated total; - USD total sums ETH × price + USDC. - `BountyCardFan.tsx`: `symbol`, `source` and `featured` on `FanCard`; Sopa cards link the claim on-site; the fan deals centre-out itself so the phone row keeps rank order. - `src/app/[locale]/page.tsx` + `src/services/poidh-sopa.ts`: `fetchSopaBounties(ttl)`. The service's 60 s cache was cutting the homepage ISR from 5 min to 1 min (confirmed in `next build`); the homepage now passes its own 300 s. A new bounty can take up to 5 min to reach `/`; `/community/bounties` stays at 1 min. - `messages/{en,pt-br}/newhome.json`: team mark, Sopa card type, partial-failure notices; section copy now says "ETH or USDC". - `docs/integrations/poidh-sopa.md` + `docs/INDEX.md`: homepage ranking and how to add a team wallet. ## Tests - [x] `tsc`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm test` (1982 passed) - [x] Unit: `bounty-hand.test.ts` (ranking, totals, codes) - [x] Component: `BountiesSection.test.tsx` (24 cases, EN + PT-BR with real messages): team mark and order, stranger ranking, totals, USDC-only pool, no ETH price, each source failing alone, both failing, loading, empty, six-card cap. Mutation-checked: breaking the team flag or the totals gate fails it. - [x] E2E: `tests/e2e/home-bounties.spec.ts` on live data: team card raised and claiming on-site, poidh card claim on poidh.xyz, 320/375/768 px with no horizontal scroll, PT-BR copy, light/dark, no page or hydration errors - [x] `next build` + `next start`: e2e 18/18 (with `i18n.spec.ts`); `/`, `/pt-br`, `/community/bounties`, `sopa/0`, `sopa/1` and both APIs return 200 - [ ] Vercel preview (needs a SOPA team member to authorize the deploy) - [ ] Real check on a phone ## Not in this PR - Who counts as "team" is only the SOPA wallet so far. Other members' bounties show, but without the mark, until their wallets are added. - A partial Sopa read on the server can still deal the hand without Sopa cards and let them join after hydration. Rare, and the same as `/community/bounties` today. - Card backs show raw markdown headings (`## Goal`). Pre-existing for poidh cards too.

In `vlad441/ncpp`, modules such as `String` and `CString` lacked unit test coverage.      - Substring and searching (`erase`, `insert`, `replace`, `find`, `rfind`, `starts_with`, `ends_with`, `contains`).
     - Edge cases (null / zero length, out-of-bounds indices, empty strings).
